newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent holds steady after London's slide.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent holds steady after London's slide.

text.p: Brent crude futures were steady at midday on Monday in Asia, holding London levels after the slump in prices on Friday.
July Brent on SIMEX was untraded but quoted at $17.70/$17.93 per barrel, after London dropped 62 cents on Friday to $17.70.
July NYMEX crude pared 12 cents of Friday's New York losses to last trade on ACCESS at $18.91 per barrel. The contract shed 87 cents in New York on Friday.
Rising crude stocks, high refinery runs and ample Brent supplies weighed on the two key markets last week. A fall through technical chart points, which sparked stop-loss orders, added to the slide.
